name: linkedin-jobs-scraper
description: High-performance TypeScript scraper for LinkedIn Jobs with proxy and Lambda support

scripts.sam:local:linkedin: sam build && sam local invoke LinkedInScraperFunction -e event.json
scripts.sam:local:naukri: sam build && sam local invoke NaukriScraperFunction -e event.json
scripts.sam:local:simplyhired: sam build && sam local invoke SimplyHiredScraperFunction -e event.json
scripts.sam:local:indeed: sam build && sam local invoke IndeedScraperFunction -e event.json
scripts.sam:deploy: sam validate --lint && sam build --parallel && sam deploy  --no-confirm-changeset
